questions: Have you ever been diagnosed with a thyroid problem?
Do you currently smoke, or have you smoked in the past?
Have you noticed any change in your weight over the last several months?
Do you feel your heart racing or pounding, even at rest?
Do you often feel hot when others around you are comfortable?
Do your hands tremble or shake?
Have you noticed any double vision, especially when looking up or to the side?
Do you have any pain in or around your right eye, particularly with eye movement?
Has your vision in the right eye become blurred or decreased recently?
Do you have a family history of thyroid disease?
Have you had any other autoimmune conditions (e.g., type 1 diabetes, rheumatoid arthritis, vitiligo)?
Did this eye problem come on gradually over weeks to months?
Is the prominence of your eye new compared to how you looked a year ago?
Have you recently been pregnant or given birth in the last year?
